title: The Place for Worship

questions.question: What were the Israelites to do to detailed places of pagan worship?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:2 (ESV): "You shall surely destroy all the places where the nations whom you shall dispossess served their gods..."

questions.question: Where were the Israelites to offer their burnt offerings?
options: At the place the Lord would choose
questions.correctAnswer: At the place the Lord would choose
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:5 (ESV): "But you shall seek the place that the LORD your God will choose... to put his name and make his habitation there."

questions.question: What principle applied to eating meat (not sacrifices) in their towns?
options: They could eat it clearly, like gazelle or deer
They had to sacrifice it first
questions.correctAnswer: They could eat it clearly, like gazelle or deer
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:15, 22 (ESV): "...you may kill and eat meat within any of your towns... Just as the gazelle or the deer is eaten, so you may eat of it..."

questions.question: What were they strictly forbidden to eat?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:23 (ESV): "Only be sure that you do not eat the blood, for the blood is the life..."

questions.question: Why should they not inquire about how the nations served their gods?
options: So they would not be ensnared to follow them
questions.correctAnswer: So they would not be ensnared to follow them
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:30 (ESV): "take care that you be not ensnared to follow them... and that you do not inquire about their gods..."

questions.question: What specifically abominable act did the nations do for their gods?
options: Burned their sons and daughters in the fire
questions.correctAnswer: Burned their sons and daughters in the fire
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:31 (ESV): "...for they even burn their sons and their daughters in the fire to their gods."

questions.question: What should not be forsaken as long as they lived in the land?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:19 (ESV): "Take care that you do not neglect the Levite as long as you live in your land."

questions.question: Where must the tithe of grain, wine, and oil be eaten?
options: Before the Lord in the place He chooses
questions.correctAnswer: Before the Lord in the place He chooses
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:17–18 (ESV): "You may not eat within your towns the tithe... but you shall eat them before the Lord your God in the place that the Lord your God will choose..."

questions.question: When can they expand their borders?
options: When the Lord enlarges their territory as promised
questions.correctAnswer: When the Lord enlarges their territory as promised
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:20 (ESV): "When the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he has promised you..."

questions.question: Who should rejoice at the chosen place?
options: You, your sons, daughters, servants, and the Levite
questions.correctAnswer: You, your sons, daughters, servants, and the Levite
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:12 (ESV): "And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you and your sons and your daughters, your male servants and your female servants, and the Levite..."

questions.question: What is the warning regarding "every place you see"?
options: Do not offer burnt offerings there
questions.correctAnswer: Do not offer burnt offerings there
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:13 (ESV): "Take care that you do not offer your burnt offerings at any place that you see."

questions.question: Regarding the unclean and clean eating meat in towns, who may eat it?
options: Both the unclean and the clean alike
questions.correctAnswer: Both the unclean and the clean alike
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:22 (ESV): "...the unclean and the clean alike may eat of it."

questions.question: How should the blood be treated when killing meat to eat?
options: Poured out on the earth like water
questions.correctAnswer: Poured out on the earth like water
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:16 (ESV): "Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it out on the earth like water."

questions.question: Why must the blood be poured out?
options: That it may go well with you and your children
questions.correctAnswer: That it may go well with you and your children
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:25 (ESV): "You shall not eat it, that it may go well with you and with your children after you..."

questions.question: What is the "life" of the meat?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 12:23 (ESV): "...for the blood is the life, and you shall not eat the life with the flesh."

key_verse_text: But you shall seek the place that the LORD your God will choose out of all your tribes to put his name and make his habitation there. There you shall go. (ESV)
